title: tenant-shelving-and-crosszone-circuit-hold
author: Aisha Khatri
release_notes: Introduces tenant shelving mode (soft-degrade) and a cross-zone circuit hysteresis controller. Hotfixes KV drain race during shelf transitions. Backwards-compatible; enabled behind feature flag shelve_mode_enabled.
description:
Summary: Add a tenant 'shelving' path that temporarily reduces feature surface when a tenant repeatedly breaches SLOs instead of instant eviction; add a cross-zone circuit 'hold' (hysteresis) controller to reduce flip-flopping of circuit breakers during regional pressure events; fix a KV-drain race observed during a canary incident that caused brief 5xx spikes.
Motivation: during the last incident we saw two negative effects: (1) tenants hitting soft SLO thresholds were immediately escalated to hard eviction which caused cascading retries and higher tail latency across nodes; (2) circuit states were oscillating across zones, triggering repeated rejoin/drain cycles. Shelving provides a graduated, observable degradation that preserves core functionality (reads and short prompts) while shedding expensive paths (batch-heavy routes, long-context generations). The hysteresis controller enforces a small, configurable cool-down window across regions before allowing a circuit re-open; combined with a lightweight telemetry-backed quorum check this reduces oscillation and regional thrashing.
Hotfix: KV drain procedure could race with shelf transition leading to stale cache pointers and occasional 500s for a small fraction of requests; this PR serializes the transition and adds a short safety checkpoint to guarantee KV eviction completion before route switch.
Changes (high level):
- runtime/tenant_manager: add shelving state machine, shelve/unshelve transitions, API hooks for route selectors
- runtime/circuit/coordinator: introduce crosszone_hysteresis controller and quorum probe
- runtime/kv: serialized drain helper and drain completion signal
- api/gateway: route selector updates to honor 'shelved' routes with degraded config
- console/telemetry: new metric tenant_shelved_total and circuit_hysteresis_events
- tests/integration: end-to-end shelving scenarios and kv-drain regression test
- docs: release note and operational runbook snippet

Testing:
- unit: 32 new unit tests for state transitions and drain serialization
- integration: two new scenarios validated in CI (shelving flow and kv-drain regression)
- load: manual local perf run showed <2% p99 increase for non-shelved tenants and ~40% reduction in CPU for shelved tenants on the same node
CI: initial run failed on a flaky test in tests/integration/shelving_test.go due to timeout; replaced a real-time sleep with a wait-for-condition loop and re-ran. All checks green on final run (lint, unit, integration, e2e-smoke).
Review thread (summary):
- Luis Romero (reviewer): "Can we make the default shelving TTL conservative and expose it via runtime flags? Also add a metric for shelve_duration distribution."
Author reply: "Agree; shelving TTL is now configurable via tenant_manager.shelve_ttl and we added tenant_shelve_duration histogram to telemetry."
- Priya Desai (reviewer): "Concern about cross-zone quorum probes adding additional network chatter during scale events."
Author reply: "Quorum probe is designed to be a single lightweight UDP probe to a small set of peers (configurable probe_set_size=3). We added rate limiting and exponential backoff; details in comments in hysteresis.go."
- Evan Zhao (reviewer, authored hyst controller): "Verified hysteresis reduces flip rate in synthetic oscillation test by ~75%."
- Ops signoff (SRE rotation): "Runbook snippet is sufficient for initial rollout; suggest 72-hour canary."
Approvals: Luis Romero approved; Priya Desai approved after TTL config change; Ops gave canary thumbs-up.
Merge decision: squash-and-merge to keep history concise.
Deployment plan:
- feature flag shelve_mode_enabled = off by default
- Canary group: 5% of tenants in us-west-2 for 72 hours with detailed telemetry (shelve events, kv-drain-timings, circuit flips)
- If stable, stage to 25% then full rollout over a week with monitoring alerts:
  - alert: tenant_shelved_rate > baseline * 3 for 1h
  - alert: circuit_hysteresis_events > baseline * 5 and correlated error spike
Hotfix notes: this PR contains a targeted fix for the KV-drain race; that part is safe to enable immediately behind the existing kv_safe_transitions flag.
Post-merge actions:
- Create Linear task to add UI toggle in Console for shelved tenants (ENG-2010)
- Add a canary dashboard panel for tenant_shelved_total and circuit_hysteresis_events (SRE-75)
Rollout outcome: merged to main on 2026-03-03 via squash; initial canary started same day. Follow-up: telemetry will be evaluated after 72h canary; if any regressions found we'll roll the flag back and collect additional traces.
